instruction: Configure VLC media player to save recordings to the Desktop folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to configure VLC's recording folder setting to Desktop (/home/user/Desktop). This involves navigating to VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Show All > Input/Codecs > Record directory or file name) and setting the path. The evaluator reads VLC's configuration file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) and checks if the 'input-record-path' setting matches '/home/user/Desktop'.
metadata.similar_to_original: Both tasks involve VLC media player configuration. Original task sets wallpaper from video frame (UI interaction), this task configures recording folder path (preferences navigation). Similar difficulty and number of steps.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks VLC recording folder configuration by reading vlcrc config file
Getter extracts VLC config from platform-specific paths (Linux: ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc)
Metric correctly parses config file and checks 'input-record-path' setting
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is semantically correct for Desktop folder on Ubuntu
Data flow is correct: getter extracts config -> metric parses and checks setting -> compares with expected
Metric handles edge cases: missing file, missing config key, parsing errors
Expected parameter handling is correct: directly accesses expected['recording_folder_path'] from rules dict
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to close VLC or trigger settings save to ensure config changes are written to vlcrc file. VLC may buffer preferences in memory and only write to disk when closed or explicitly saved.
Minor: Current implementation assumes settings are immediately persisted to disk, which may not be the case if VLC is still running
